response.original_title: Heir to the Artisanship of Lane Xang
response.overview: “Heir to the Artisanship of Lane Xang,” we meet Nelanith Lattanakone, a grandson in the Lattanakone silversmith family in Luang Prabang. At 23 years old, Nelanith is focused on developing his artistic skills and continuing the family business with knowledge passed down from the Lane Xang era. This profile of Nelanith will showcase traditional cultural expressions in Luang Prabang.
